items.markdown:
Amazon uses a data-driven, customer-centric pricing model designed to offer low prices every day and capture maximum market share.[[1]](https://vasogroup.com/what-is-amazons-pricing-strategy/)[[2]](https://insightleap.com/blog/advertising-on-amazon/decoding-amazons-pricing-strategy)

### Core Strategies Used by Amazon

- **Dynamic Pricing:** Algorithms change prices multiple times a day based on real-time data like supply, competitor rates, and demand.[[1]](https://www.intelligencenode.com/blog/amazon-pricing-strategies-model/)[[2]](https://vasogroup.com/what-is-amazons-pricing-strategy/)
- **Loss Leaders:** Popular items are sold at or below cost to attract shoppers who then buy high-margin products.[[1]](https://insightleap.com/blog/advertising-on-amazon/decoding-amazons-pricing-strategy)[[2]](https://vasogroup.com/what-is-amazons-pricing-strategy/)
- **Economies of Scale:** Buying in bulk lets Amazon secure lower supplier costs and pass those savings to buyers.[[1]](https://vasogroup.com/what-is-amazons-pricing-strategy/)[[2]](https://insightleap.com/blog/advertising-on-amazon/decoding-amazons-pricing-strategy)
- **Bundling and Cross-Selling:** Grouping related items together increases overall cart value and product visibility.[[1]](https://insightleap.com/blog/advertising-on-amazon/decoding-amazons-pricing-strategy)

### Strategies for Third-Party Sellers

- **The Buy Box Focus:** Pricing items competitively helps sellers win the featured Buy Box for higher sales.[[1]](https://sell.amazon.com/blog/amazon-pricing-strategies)[[2]](https://www.intelligencenode.com/blog/amazon-pricing-strategies-model/)[[3]](https://netpeak.us/blog/amazon-pricing-strategy-how-to-stay-competitive-without-selling-your-brand-short/)
- **Cost-Plus Baseline:** Calculate total expenses—including product costs, referral fees, FBA fulfillment, and storage—to find your absolute price floor.[[1]](https://goaura.com/blog/amazon-pricing-strategy)[[2]](https://www.informedrepricer.com/blog/amazon-pricing-strategy)
- **Strikethrough Pricing:** Listing a higher original price and lowering the current price creates a visible discount tag to attract buyers.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/HzqIcRpGdbg)
- **Automated Repricing:** Tools adjust prices automatically to match market changes without breaking platform fair-pricing policies.[[1]](https://sell.amazon.com/blog/amazon-pricing-strategies)
